source.title: Some open problems in differential geometry

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH document URL https://zbmath.org/3479732. Local shell fetching could not resolve zbmath.org or api.zbmath.org because network access is unavailable in the execution sandbox. Resolver metadata from the local zbMATH shard and zbMATH-indexed author/profile search identifies the exact work as Leon Green, 'Some open problems in differential geometry', Zbl 0306.53031, published in Differential Geometry, Part 1, Proceedings of Symposia in Pure Mathematics 27.1, 1975, pages 407-412.

Access failure mode: metadata_only. The zbMATH resolver record in the local shard has no full-text links. Exact-work searches were limited to the title, title plus PDF, title plus 1975, title plus Leon Green, title plus Zbl 0306.53031, and title plus MR 0377707.

Rejected recovered candidates because they did not provide readable exact-work problem text: AMS eBook and bookstore pages expose only table-of-contents metadata for the volume; the AMS endmatter PDF exposes only page listings; the Leon Green zbMATH author profile exposes only bibliographic metadata; MathNet and other pages cite the work only in references; unrelated later papers with similar open-problem titles are different works.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered.

The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from bibliographic metadata, table-of-contents listings, citation references, search snippets, or other works. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
